program.name: HDL vector-add fixture
program.source:
LDR R1, [%threadIdx]
CONST R2, 64
ADD R2, R2, %threadIdx
LDR R3, [R2]
ADD R4, R1, R3
CONST R5, 128
ADD R5, R5, %threadIdx
STR R4, [R5]
RET
